_signed_off_phases_note: HUMAN SIGN-OFF, and the only thing that unlocks a `gated_until` tool. Add a phase id here ONLY after you have seen its verification pass. It lives in this file, not in feature_list.json, because this file is a protected path and the feature list is the agent's own worklog — an agent that could unlock its own tools by writing "status": "passing" is self-promoting. Empty or absent means NO phase is signed off, so every gated tool stays locked: fails closed.
